- /task/README.md R1 authority, latest explicit revision wins. Normalize schemas 1/2: event_id/id, board/device, epoch/boot, sequence/seq, action/kind uppercase, tx/transaction, slot 0/1 to A/B, digest/sha256, success/ok bool, time/timestamp. Missing tx/slot/digest None. Global event-ID grouping: equal normalized payload ignoring timestamp/schema spelling -> keep one, extras duplicate_replays. Multiple payloads -> exclude ALL ID rows, no replay count, one conflicted_id and duplicate_conflict at minimum (board,epoch,sequence,event_id).
- R1 transitions: successful baseline initializes active (slot,digest), verified exact-pair history and initial epoch. Epoch advances preserve pending/history/active. Successful RESET clears all pending; failed -> reset_failed/no mutation. Failed STAGE -> stage_failed/no mutation; successful replaces tx pending image, verified=False. VERIFY absent pending -> verify_without_stage; failed -> verify_failed preserving previous flag; successful mismatch -> verify_mismatch and clears flag; matching success flags verified and adds exact pair history. Failed COMMIT always commit_failed; success absent pending -> commit_without_stage; mismatch -> commit_mismatch; unverified -> commit_unverified; accepted updates active, applied_commits++, removes only that tx. Failed ROLLBACK -> rollback_failed; success only exact pair in board history allowed, updates active, accepted_rollbacks++, clears all pending; else rollback_unverified. History survives all epochs/resets/mismatches/failed verification.
- Default report exact keys boards/incidents/totals; boards {board,epoch,active_slot,active_digest} sorted board; incidents {board,epoch,sequence,event_id,reason} sorted all 5 fields; totals board_count,applied_commits,accepted_rollbacks,duplicate_replays,conflicted_ids,rejected_events=len(incidents). No timestamps/paths/runtime metadata.
- Recorded assumptions in /task/PHASE_NOTES.md: successful baseline runs first irrespective timestamp; then sort (epoch,timestamp,sequence,event_id). Equivalent replays use minimum timestamp for input permutation invariance (R1 unspecified representative choice). VERIFY without stage precedence over failure. If baseline removed by conflict, initialize null active/history-empty for surviving events; boards with no retained events omitted. Field types/actions follow declared schemas; malformed inputs not defined. Explicitly do not infer contract revisions from fixture timestamps.
